purpose: Separate the current exploratory retrospective study from a future confirmatory evaluation.

current_study.presentation_review_scope: 15 selected spans received additional assistant review

allowed: exploratory maximum test AUPRC across candidate signals
exploratory maximum test F1 across candidate signals
results conditional on the selected high-priority question subset
disallowed: representative error rate across all business questions

future_confirmation_protocol.objective: Compare frozen internal-state, literature-grounded, and evidence-aware detector families on fresh context-separated data.

data_policy.preferred: fresh business contexts, model outputs, or a second dataset not used for exploratory signal selection
data_policy.fallback: regenerate a context-grouped split where the same evidence context cannot cross train, dev, and confirmation sets
data_policy.group_key: evidence source plus business period plus canonical evidence-row payload
data_policy.sample_selection: select annotation targets before reviewing generated-answer correctness
data_policy.confirmation_set_access: keep labels and detector comparisons sealed until extraction rules, signals, thresholds, and analysis code are frozen

evaluation_tracks.oracle_span_diagnostics: score frozen detector families on independently annotated fact spans
evaluation_tracks.claim_extraction: measure claim-span extraction precision, recall, and boundary overlap separately
evaluation_tracks.end_to_end_verification: evaluate extracted claim plus evidence decision without using gold span locations

annotation_policy.reviewers: two independent reviewers for the confirmation subset
annotation_policy.blinding: reviewers do not see detector scores or each other's labels
annotation_policy.agreement: report binary label agreement and span-boundary agreement before adjudication
annotation_policy.adjudication: resolve disagreements with a documented third pass

detector_policy.candidate_status: selected from the exploratory study and requiring confirmation on fresh data
comparison_families: internal uncertainty: entropy, top-2 margin, and energy-style signals
literature-grounded: Semantic Entropy, TOHA, and entity-level detection where feasible
detector_policy.test_policy: do not choose detector families, thresholds, prompts, or verifier rules from confirmation-set results
